name: Kai Mohammadi-Fredriksen
role: Network intrusion and digital warfare specialist — netrunner
location: The Canopy — elevated walkway district above Geartown, near Clark and Addison
description:
Ilhan Strom-Duah are tall and rawboned, the kind of frame that suggests either malnutrition or efficiency depending on the decade. At 25, they have the kind of face that changes depending on the light — trustworthy in daylight, dangerous after dark. The chrome is visible — cyberears with directional microphones and sound dampening — can hear whispers a — and they make no effort to hide it.

Born and raised in GLMZ, third generation — they have the city in their blood, its rhythms in their bones, its cruelty in their expectations. They work as a netrunner out of The Canopy, taking contracts that match their skills and their risk tolerance, which are higher than most people consider healthy.

Everyone who's worked with Ilhan Strom-Duah agrees on two things: they are worth the fee, and they are terrible company at dinner.

core_fears: Being captured alive — death is preferable to corporate interrogation
Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
That their reputation is built on luck, not skill, and the luck is finite
core_desires: The perfect run — one job so clean it becomes legend
Knowledge — to understand the systems that grind people down
To build something that outlasts the next contract cycle
coping_mechanisms: Connection — finds someone to talk to, even if it's a bartender or a cat
Compartmentalization — work feelings and personal feelings exist in separate boxes
Control — micromanages everything within reach to compensate for the chaos everywhere else
blind_spots: Refuses to update their mental model of people — first impressions calcify into permanent judgments
Thinks speed can substitute for planning because it's worked so far
Assumes their skill set is more transferable than it actually is
psychology.secret: Ilhan Strom-Duah killed someone who didn't deserve it on a job three years ago and has never told anyone. The face appears in dreams weekly.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Old-fashioned formal diction — sounds like they learned to speak from pre-collapse recordings.
speech_patterns.cadence: Low and even — the vocal equivalent of still water.
verbal_tics: Uses technical jargon for everything, including emotions
Hums tunelessly when planning — the team has learned to wait for the humming to stop
example_lines: "Every system has a door. Most of them have a door the architect forgot about."
"I don't hack networks. I have conversations with them. Most of them are lonely."
"The ice they're running is military-grade. That means expensive, not impenetrable."

story_hooks: A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Ilhan Strom-Duah's reputation — and a price for silence
A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Ilhan Strom-Duah owes a personal debt to
Ilhan Strom-Duah intercepts intelligence about a threat to their district and must decide between profit and protection
narrative_function: Ilhan Strom-Duah represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. Their stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Cyberears with directional microphones and sound dampening — can hear whispers at 50 meters. Synthetic blood with oxygen-carrying nanites — doesn't tire, heals faster
daily_life: Between contracts, maintains a cover identity — mundane work, mundane hours, mundane neighbors. The transition from civilian to runner and back requires a conscious effort that gets easier with practice and more disturbing with self-awareness.
affiliation: Semi-independent — recurring contracts with mid-tier fixers

weaknesses: risk-averse to the point of missed opportunities
inability to delegate — must control everything personally

decision_rules: Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Projects confidence but makes decisions from a foundation of fear they've never examined
Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
habits: Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
Sleeps with one hand on a weapon — has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
breaking_points: Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity
Being forced to harm a civilian — collateral damage that can't be rationalized
Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap

physical_description.heritage: Cosmopolitan diaspora blend — predominantly East Asian structure (27.6%) with significant Middle Eastern (20.6%) and Hispanic/Latin American (19.3%) ancestry, substantial Southeast Asian (18.5%) influence, Northern European (10.6%) undertones, and Sub-Saharan African (3.4%) contributions creating a complexion and feature set that defies single-region categorization. The result is a face that reads as authentically global rather than anchored to any single genetic origin.
physical_description.build: Rawboned and efficiently lean — long limbs with minimal subcutaneous fat, the frame of someone who runs on function rather than bulk. Suggests either deliberate asceticism or the metabolic reality of synthetic blood.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with faded blonde undertones — natural color allowed to fade under city light and neglect
physical_description.hair_style: Shoulder-length, often pulled back asymmetrically or left to fall across one side of the face
physical_description.eye_color: Pale grey with networked microvasculature visible at the corners — indication of synthetic blood circulation
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium bronze — a harmonious blend reflecting East Asian and Southeast Asian base with Middle Eastern and Latin American golden undertones, further desaturated by sun-deprivation from spending nights in the Canopy and jacked-in to networks
physical_description.complexion: High, defined cheekbones with gentle prominence reflecting East Asian ancestry, strong angular jaw with slight width typical of Southeast Asian genetics, dark intelligent eyes set with the slight epicanthic fold common across East and Southeast Asian populations. Skin is clear but shows the faint texture of someone who doesn't prioritize sleep — fine lines around the eyes from screen fatigue and focus-locked concentration. Subtle warmth to the undertones from Middle Eastern and Latin American heritage. No visible scarring on the face; the damage is internal.
distinguishing_marks: Surgical scars at both temples where cyberear neural interface ports integrate with the skull — thin, precise lines barely visible unless the light hits at certain angles
A thin white line running from left wrist to mid-forearm, old enough to be almost invisible but present under certain lighting — a reminder of early-career mistakes with jack-in equipment
Faint tattoo along the right collarbone: a stylized circuit pattern that mirrors actual neural pathways, done in conductive ink that glows faintly when jacked into a live network
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Cyberears dominate the visual profile — brushed titanium and dark chrome, slightly larger than baseline human ears with visible directional microphone arrays at the auricle edge and faint LED indicators that pulse with incoming audio data. The ears have minimal attempt at cosmetic blending; they announce themselves. Wrists show subtle port scars where jack-in cables connect, usually hidden by clothing but visible when they move.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and purposeful — no wasted motion, but not rigid. Moves with the particular grace of someone who's spent significant time in VR spaces and has to relearn physical embodiment daily. Head positioning is deliberate; they orient toward sound sources with the precision of someone using directional microphones rather than moving naturally. Eyes track movement in their peripheral vision with unusual attentiveness. When relaxed (rare), there's a slight tremor in the hands — the physical price of synthetic blood and enhanced neural firing rates.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 utilitarian with deliberately non-descript elements. Black or dark grey reinforced synthetic jacket (thermal regulation for temperature-spiked rig sessions), loose cargo pants with multiple sealed pockets (some for hardware, some as misdirection), unmarked steel-toed boots with reinforced ankle support (never know when you need to move fast through physical space). Underneath: fitted black layer that wouldn't stand out in either a corpo lobby or a Tier 5 dive. No logos, no brand signaling — visibility is operational liability. One piece of visible jewelry: a silver ring on the right thumb, always worn, possibly functional (induction point for wireless data transfer) or possibly just a talisman from before they fully committed to the life.
